visualCharacteristics.purpose: article listing fed by the site page index (/query-index.json)

contentPattern.structure: no authored cards; optional key/value rows: index (default /query-index.json), path (folder to list; default the current page folder, then its parent), template, limit (page size; 6 hub / 4 latest), title (latest heading), see all (link for the latest list)

usage.when: article hub pages (Most Recent / Search tabs + Load more) and the article sidebar "Latest articles" list

reuseGuidance: Use the default on hub pages; add latest in the sidebar section. Pages must be in the query index with title, description, image and a date (date/publishDate, else lastModified).
